suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as postinfectious rheumatologic complication. Require documented Salmonella or Shigella infection preceding separately diagnosed reactive arthritis. Preserve the postinfectious temporal relationship and do not infer arthritis from infection alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Shigella / Salmonella Infections matches the source-specific phenotype
Independent diagnosis of Reactive Arthritis with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors
